ビキニ姿の彼女を描いてください。しかし、彼女の胸はかなり大きいの. だから、彼女のビキニは、それらを維持するのに苦労している。少し困ったような表情をしているはずです。

参考用のキャラクターイラストは以下のページ
https://cysh.no/art/cyshbikini.html (Cyshのビキニ姿のイラストが掲載されています。)
https://cysh.no/art/refs/cyshrefs.html (Cyshの一般的なイラストはこのページにある。)

Hello, nice to meet you. I'd like you to draw an artwork for me please. Sorry for my bad Japanese.

Are you familiar with the "gold week bikini" trend that happened about 2 months ago? It's where artists draw girls in golden bikinis to celebrate "golden week" in Japan.

You can see examples of the golden bikini here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hNAF6JswTDryMHvFeiBsnBAX66MbtnGy?usp=drive_link

So I'd like you to draw my character named Quetzal wearing a golden bikini. You can pose her how you want to. I'd like her to be happy and enjoying her summer vacation. Please include a beach background as well if possible.

Quetzal's references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zm-2BFEYDr4jmT7b_9WrJQKVi8BX3Z5I?usp=drive_link

In some of the images, her hair looks black. Her hair color is meant to be a dark brown.

Thank you very much for your consideration.

Hello(⁎⁍̴̛ᴗ⁍̴̛⁎)
If it’s okay, I would like to request a header image for X (Twitter) and also a profile picture!

My character is a maid at a virtual café. While working, she appears expressionless and highly competent, but in private, she’s actually a clumsy otaku. After work, she enjoys curling up in bed to play games. Occasionally, she makes “dark cuisine” cakes and cookies and forces them on everyone. ( ̀⌄ ́)

Please feel free to use your creativity for the design! You can change her outfit, but if possible, keep some key features.

The intended uses are for Vtuber streaming events and display on social media.

If it’s possible to provide PSD data with separate layers for the character and background, that would be greatly appreciated!

Hello, my name is Aki. It's nice to meet you! I really like seeing your art, and I was hoping I could make a request please. Could you draw this dullahan girl for me please?

https://x.com/HINJAKUGORIRA/status/1857555167576732033

I would like to see her with the head that has black hair and red eyes. The head should be detached from her body, so you can tell she's a dullahan, and I would like to be able to see her neck stump attached to her body. Also, I would like her to be wearing a sun hairpin, like the one the head with brown hair is wearing. Lastly, I would like her to be wearing a boob window sweater. 

I apologize if the request is a little complicated! Thank you very much for considering me!
If you don't mind, I would like to have Sakurako or Karin in a bikini or bunny suit.
